module.name: app:services/project-planning/project-planning-inline-delivery
module.jsdoc:
@module app:services/project-planning-inline-delivery
职责：向活跃 projectPlanning runner 报告本轮 Base_NavigationInfo DataView 提交结果。
边界：只核对 captured DevSystem workspace 的蓝图 DataView 回执，不创建第二保存入口。
AI用途：理解 projectPlanning inline runner 的提交结果和仍待保存状态。

ProjectPlanningDeliveryContext.name: ProjectPlanningDeliveryContext
ProjectPlanningDeliveryContext.jsdoc: projectPlanning inline run 落盘时携带的 editor 与蓝图保存策略。

attributes.name: editor
attributes.jsdoc: 本轮 captured ProjectWorkspace，持有当前项目蓝图和配置页模型。

attributes.name: saveBlueprintAfterRun
attributes.jsdoc: Agent Run 成功结束后是否自动保存蓝图变更；false 时仅标记 dirty 不落盘。

attributes.name: dataViewBlueprintSaved
attributes.jsdoc: True only after a live DataView command returned its accepted receipt and readback.

attributes.name: dataViewBlueprintPending
attributes.jsdoc: True when the original DataView command still needs explicit Save All recovery.

attributes.name: dataViewBlueprintRepeatRejected
attributes.jsdoc: A later plan mutation was attempted after this run had already issued its single DataView command.
